title: Jed Hunter (miniquest)
start: Talk to Lookout Ekahi who is on the northern dock on Waiko near Sarim's Revenge.

items.t: Uncharted island map (to kill 3 Gu ronin)

kills.t: 3 Gu ronin (level 119, scale to your level)

steps.t: Talk to Lookout Ekahi beside your ship in either Waiko or Aminishi. [Chat: 1 Jed Hunter miniquest. › Accept › 1 Yes, I promise.]

sub.t: If you have just completed the Head of the Family miniquest then you may need to relog for this option to appear.

steps.t: Talk to Bosun Higgs beside your ship. [Chat: 1 Jed Hunter miniquest.]
Talk to Sojobo in the centre of Waiko marketplace.
Kill 3 Gu ronin on uncharted isles.
Return to Bosun Higgs with the Tetsu set. [Chat: 1 Jed Hunter miniquest.]
Talk to Navigator Jemi beside your ship. [Chat: 1 Jed Hunter miniquest.]
Talk to Sea Witch Kaula on the north-western shore of Whale's Maw. [Chat: 4 Ask about communicating with the Thalassus.]

sub.t: You may have to speak to her twice to give her the tortle shell bowls.

steps.t: Talk to Navigator Jemi while standing next to Kaula.
Go back to the ship and talk to Navigator Jemi. [Chat: 1 Jed Hunter miniquest.]
Talk to Quartermaster Gully beside your ship. [Chat: 1 Jed Hunter miniquest.]
Talk to Rosie in the centre of Waiko.
Deliver the buoyancy materials back to Quartermaster Gully. [Chat: 1 Jed Hunter miniquest.]
Talk to Lookout Ekahi. [Chat: 1 Jed Hunter miniquest.]
Talk to Yuehanxun the Dealer in the south-east of Waiko. She is at the last hut in the South of Waiko, north of the water barrel.
p: Ekahi "kills" you so Yuehanxan will send him coordinates

steps.t: Talk to Lookout Ekahi at the boat to set sail. [Chat: 1 Jed Hunter miniquest. › 1 Yes.]
p: Jed is confronted by the crew of Sarim's Revenge.

steps.t: Once on the ship, talk to Lookout Ekahi again. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Once on the other ship, unlock the hold in the centre of the ship. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
p: Jed's escape plan goes unexpectedly wrong
Jemi asks for help from Sea Witch Kaula.

get_inside.text: Players can travel to Waiko by talking to Quartermaster Gully located in Port Sarim, or Menaphos, after the player has completed the quest Impressing the Locals. The Arc journal is an easy way to get to Quartermaster Gully.
Waiko teleports, purchased from Boni's Waiko Reward Shop for 5 chimes, can be broken to teleport the player to the merchant hub on Waiko.
